_about: The radio buff (the owner, 2026-10-26: "respawn +60%"; srp-026g/docs/notes/booster-buffs.md). The Radio (respawn_booster, dict item of kind booster) works carried: its one default modification 1220 (drop_weight 0, no other item has it) adds respawn_time_modifier (index 60) to the kit's lists, and the respawn rule at a death (0x316AA0) makes the delay respawn_time x max(0, 1 + modifier 60), up to the 50 ms grid. Respawn speed +60 % is the time x 1/1.6: the modifier -0.2 -> -0.375 (lobby_info with it), so 8 s -> 5 s in Team Deathmatch, 10 s -> 6.25 s in the battery modes and Research (was 6.4 s and 8 s). The card: the stock line 124 "Respawn time" (lower is better) would show -37.5 %, so the modification's line is a new card line 135 "Respawn speed" (higher is better, a percentage as 124: ui_properties without mod_type), made like 124 after 134, its text st_srp_respawn_speed in the six localization tables, prop_value 0.60: "Respawn speed: +60%". Line 124 stays as the game has it (1221, which nothing carries, keeps it).
